knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 商户临时表-关联终端表给商户打标签
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: INSERT INTO VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_01 SELECT mect_cd, MAX(CASE WHEN mect_vld_flg='1' AND flg1='1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS pos_flg, MAX(CASE WHEN mect_vld_flg='1' AND flg2='1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS mobile_flg FROM (SELECT T1.mect_cd, CASE WHEN (T2.term_no<>'' AND T2.term_sts_cd<>'2' AND T2.term_lock_flag='0' AND T1.activa_flag='1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS flg1, CASE WHEN (T1.txn_autho_mode_cd='2' AND T1.move_pay_mect_no<>'' AND T1.move_pay_flag='1' AND T2.term_lock_flag='0') OR (T1.txn_autho_mode_cd='0' AND T1.move_pay_mect_no<>'' AND T1.move_pay_flag='1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS flg2 FROM F_PT_POSP_MECT_INF T1 LEFT JOIN F_CO_POSP_TERM_INF T2 ON T1.mect_cd=T2.mect_cd) P GROUP BY P.mect_cd
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: INSERT INTO VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_01 SELECT mect_cd, MAX(CASE WHEN mect_vld_flg='1' AND flg1='1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS pos_flg, MAX(CASE WHEN mect_vld_flg='1' AND flg2='1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS mobile_flg FROM (SELECT T1.mect_cd, CASE WHEN (T2.term_no<>'' AND T2.term_sts_cd<>'2' AND T2.term_lock_flag='0' AND T1.activa_flag='1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS flg1, CASE WHEN (T1.txn_autho_mode_cd='2' AND T1.move_pay_mect_no<>'' AND T1.move_pay_flag='1' AND T2.term_lock_flag='0') OR (T1.txn_autho_mode_cd='0' AND T1.move_pay_mect_no<>'' AND T1.move_pay_flag='1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS flg2 FROM O_POSP_T_MERCH T1 LEFT JOIN O_POSP_T_TERM T2 ON T1.merch_id=T2.merch_id) P GROUP BY P.mect_cd
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 平台系统POS业务-关联终端表为商户打POS标志和移动端标志
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: POSP商户信息表 LEFT JOIN POSP终端信息表 ON 商户号
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 商户号、POS标志、移动端标志、商户有效标志、助农商户标志、有效终端数量

traceChains.filterConditions: start_dt <= 数据日期 AND end_dt > 数据日期
start_dt <= 数据日期 AND end_dt > 数据日期

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT merch_id FROM O_POSP_T_MERCH T1 LEFT JOIN O_POSP_T_TERM T2 ON T1.merch_id=T2.merch_id WHERE T2.term_id<>'' AND T2.n_term_stat<>'2' AND T2.n_term_lock='0' AND T1.effect_flag='1'
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 筛选有有效POS终端的商户，条件：终端号不为空、终端状态非冻结(不为2)、终端未锁定、商户启用标志为1

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT merch_id FROM O_POSP_T_MERCH WHERE mobie_flag='1' AND (auth_flag='0' OR (auth_flag='2' AND mch_no<>''))
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 筛选开通移动支付的商户，条件：移动支付标志为1，且(手机端授权或POS端授权且有移动支付商户编号)

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT merch_id FROM O_POSP_T_MERCH T1 LEFT JOIN O_POSP_T_TERM T2 ON T1.merch_id=T2.merch_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.merch_id,8,4)='5441' AND T2.n_term_stat IN ('0','1') AND T2.n_term_lock='0'
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 筛选助农商户，条件：商户号第8-11位为5441，终端状态为签退或签到，终端未锁定

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 商户临时表-合并商户信息
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: INSERT INTO VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_02 SELECT T1.mect_cd, T1.mect_name, CASE WHEN T1.move_pay_flag='1' AND T4.main_cust_no IS NOT NULL THEN T4.main_cust_no ELSE T3.main_cust_no END AS cust_no, T1.mect_lp_name, T1.lp_identt_card_no, T1.stl_acct_no FROM F_PT_POSP_MECT_INF T1 LEFT JOIN VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_01 T2 ON T1.mect_cd=T2.mect_no LEFT JOIN F_AC_CRBS_CUST_ACCT_NO T3 ON T1.stl_acct_no=T3.cust_acct_no LEFT JOIN F_AC_CRBS_CUST_ACCT_NO T4 ON T1.move_pay_stl_acct_no=T4.cust_acct_no WHERE DATE BETWEEN T1.start_dt AND T1.end_dt-1
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: SELECT T1.merch_id AS mect_cd, T1.merch_name_cn AS mect_name, CASE WHEN T1.mobie_flag='1' AND T4.KEHHAO IS NOT NULL THEN T4.KEHHAO ELSE T3.KEHHAO END AS main_cust_no FROM O_POSP_T_MERCH T1 LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T3 ON T1.settle_account=T3.CUACNO LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T4 ON T1.mobile_account=T4.CUACNO
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 平台系统POS业务-合并商户基本信息和客户账号信息
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: POSP商户信息表 LEFT JOIN 核心客户账号表 ON 结算账号，移动支付结算账号
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 商户号、商户名称、客户号、法人姓名、法人身份证号、结算账号、移动支付标志、POS标志

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT T1.merch_id, CASE WHEN T1.mobie_flag='1' AND T4.KEHHAO IS NOT NULL THEN T4.KEHHAO ELSE T3.KEHHAO END AS main_cust_no FROM O_POSP_T_MERCH T1 LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T3 ON T1.settle_account=T3.CUACNO LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T4 ON T1.mobile_account=T4.CUACNO
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 通过结算账号关联客户账号表获取主客户号，优先使用移动支付结算账号对应的客户号

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 商户临时表-加工商户机构信息
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: INSERT INTO VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_03 SELECT T1.mect_no, T1.mect_name, T1.core_cust_no, T2.ORG_NO, T2.org_abre, T2.level_scd_org_no, T2.level_scd_org_abre FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_02 T1 LEFT JOIN C_ORG_ORG_INF T2 ON T1.mect_belo_org_no=T2.org_no LEFT JOIN F_AC_CRBS_CUST_ACCT_NO T5 ON T1.move_pay_stl_acct_no=T5.cust_acct_no LEFT JOIN F_AC_CRBS_CUST_ACCT_NO T6 ON T1.stl_acct_no=T6.cust_acct_no
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: SELECT T1.mect_no, T1.mect_name, T1.core_cust_no, T2.org_no, T2.org_abre, T5.RECSTA AS move_stl_acct_no_sts_cd, T6.RECSTA AS stl_acct_no_sts_cd FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_02 T1 LEFT JOIN C_ORG_ORG_INF T2 ON T1.mect_belo_org_no=T2.org_no LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T5 ON T1.move_pay_stl_acct_no=T5.CUACNO LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T6 ON T1.stl_acct_no=T6.CUACNO
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 共性层机构管理-关联机构信息表和客户账号表获取机构名称和账号状态
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 商户临时表 LEFT JOIN 机构信息表 ON 商户所属机构号，LEFT JOIN 客户账号表 ON 结算账号和移动支付结算账号
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 商户号、所属机构号、所属机构名称、所属分行、结算账号状态、移动支付结算账号状态

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT mect_no, CASE WHEN pos_flg='1' AND mobile_flg='1' THEN 'POS+聚合' WHEN pos_flg='1' THEN 'POS' WHEN mobile_flg='1' THEN '聚合' ELSE '' END AS mect_type_cd FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_02
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 根据POS标志和移动端标志判断商户类型：POS+聚合、POS、聚合

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT mect_no, CASE WHEN cust_type_cd='01' THEN '个人户' WHEN cust_type_cd='02' THEN '对公户' END AS mect_nature_cd FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_02
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 根据客户类型判断商户性质：01-个人户，02-对公户

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 商户临时表-账户开户机构
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: INSERT INTO VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_04 SELECT T1.stl_acct_no, T2.open_acct_org_no, T3.org_abre FROM (SELECT stl_acct_no FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_03 GROUP BY 1)T1 LEFT JOIN F_AC_CRBS_CUST_ACCT_NO T2 ON T1.stl_acct_no=T2.cust_acct_no LEFT JOIN C_ORG_ORG_INF T3 ON T2.open_acct_org_no=T3.org_no
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: INSERT INTO VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_04 SELECT T1.stl_acct_no, T2.ACOPBR AS open_acct_org_no, T3.org_abre FROM (SELECT stl_acct_no FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_03 GROUP BY 1)T1 LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T2 ON T1.stl_acct_no=T2.CUACNO LEFT JOIN C_ORG_ORG_INF T3 ON T2.ACOPBR=T3.org_no
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 核心系统客户账号管理-获取结算账号的开户机构信息
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 商户临时表 LEFT JOIN 客户账号表 ON 结算账号，LEFT JOIN 机构信息表 ON 开户机构号
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 结算账号、开户机构号、机构简称

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT CUACNO AS cust_acct_no, ACOPBR AS open_acct_org_no FROM O_CRBS_BCUAC
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 通过客户账号获取开户机构号

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 插入结果表-最终商户信息
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: INSERT INTO C_CUS_POS_MECT_INF SELECT T1.mect_no, T1.mect_name, T1.core_cust_no, T1.mect_vld_flg, T1.stl_acct_no, CASE WHEN T4.aum_roll_quart_daily_avg>=500 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS base_cust_flag, CASE WHEN T4.aum_roll_quart_daily_avg>=5000 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS medi_high_side_cust_flag, NVL((CASE WHEN T9.wechat_signe_flag='1' OR T9.wbank_signe_flag='1' OR T9.mb_bank_signe_flag='1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END),'0') AS e_bank_cust_flag FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_03 T1 LEFT JOIN VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_04 T3 ON T1.stl_acct_no=T3.stl_acct_no LEFT JOIN C_CUS_PRI_CUST_AUM_INF T4 ON T1.core_cust_no=T4.cust_no LEFT JOIN C_CUS_CHAN_SIGNE_IND T9 ON T1.core_cust_no=T9.cust_no
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: INSERT INTO C_CUS_POS_MECT_INF SELECT T1.mect_no, T1.mect_name, T1.core_cust_no, T1.mect_vld_flg, T1.stl_acct_no, CASE WHEN T4.aum_roll_quart_daily_avg>=500 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS base_cust_flag, CASE WHEN T4.aum_roll_quart_daily_avg>=5000 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS medi_high_side_cust_flag, NVL((CASE WHEN T9.wechat_signe_flag='1' OR T9.wbank_signe_flag='1' OR T9.mb_bank_signe_flag='1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END),'0') AS e_bank_cust_flag FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_03 T1 LEFT JOIN VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_04 T3 ON T1.stl_acct_no=T3.stl_acct_no LEFT JOIN C_CUS_PRI_CUST_AUM_INF T4 ON T1.core_cust_no=T4.cust_no LEFT JOIN C_CUS_CHAN_SIGNE_IND T9 ON T1.core_cust_no=T9.cust_no
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 共性层客户管理-关联客户AUM和渠道签约信息，打客户标签
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 商户临时表 LEFT JOIN 客户AUM信息表 ON 客户号，LEFT JOIN 渠道签约表 ON 客户号
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 商户号、商户名称、客户号、商户有效标志、结算账号、基础客户标志、中高端客户标志、电子银行客户标志、助农商户标志

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT cust_no, CASE WHEN aum_roll_quart_daily_avg>=500 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS base_cust_flag FROM C_CUS_PRI_CUST_AUM_INF
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: AUM滚动季日均>=500元的客户为基础客户

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT cust_no, CASE WHEN aum_roll_quart_daily_avg>=5000 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS medi_high_side_cust_flag FROM C_CUS_PRI_CUST_AUM_INF
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: AUM滚动季日均>=5000元的客户为中高端客户

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT cust_no, CASE WHEN wechat_signe_flag='1' OR wbank_signe_flag='1' OR mb_bank_signe_flag='1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS e_bank_cust_flag FROM C_CUS_CHAN_SIGNE_IND
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 签约微信银行、网银或手机银行的客户为电子银行客户

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT mect_no FROM VT_C_CUS_POS_MECT_INFO_03 WHERE mect_vld_flg='1'
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 商户有效标志为1的商户为有效商户

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT T1.merch_id AS mect_no, T1.merch_name_cn AS mect_name, T3.KEHHAO AS core_cust_no, T1.settle_account AS stl_acct_no, T1.pre_lawer AS mect_lp_name, T1.precardid AS lp_identt_card_no FROM O_POSP_T_MERCH T1 LEFT JOIN O_CRBS_BCUAC T3 ON T1.settle_account=T3.CUACNO
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 获取POS商户的完整信息，包括商户号、商户名称、客户号、结算账号、法人信息等

keyBusinessRules.condition: 终端号不为空 AND 终端状态<>2(冻结) AND 终端锁定标志=0 AND 商户启用标志=1

keyBusinessRules.ruleName: 移动端有效商户判断条件
keyBusinessRules.condition: 移动支付标志=1 AND ((交易授权方式=0(手机端)) OR (交易授权方式=2(POS端) AND 移动支付商户编号不为空 AND 终端有效))
keyBusinessRules.description: 商户开通移动支付且配置正确

keyBusinessRules.condition: 商户号第8-11位='5441' AND 终端状态 IN (0签退,1签到) AND 终端锁定标志=0
keyBusinessRules.description: 商户号包含5441标识的助农商户

金融资产达到中高端客户标准

keyBusinessRules.condition: 微信签约标志=1 OR 网银签约标志=1 OR 手机银行签约标志=1
